settings.title: Settings
settings.treeDescription: A personal setting — only you see it.
settings.membersDescription: Manage access to the family archive.
settings.shareDescription: Anonymous, read-only access to the family's public data — no sign-up and no editing rights.
settings.activityDescription: Who changed what in the archive — visible to the owner only. Last 10 entries.
settings.slugWarning: The old link will stop working for every family member — including saved bookmarks.
settings.deleteBody: All people, relationships, events, media and stories of this family will be permanently deleted. This cannot be undone.
settings.deleteConfirmLabel: To confirm, type the family name: {name}
settings.deleteRowBody: Permanently deletes the family and all its data — people, relationships, events, media and stories.
settings.focusHint: Just for you — other family members see the tree from their own point.

roleDescriptions.owner: Full access: manages members and settings, can edit and delete everything.
roleDescriptions.editor: Can edit the tree, profiles and events — like an owner, but without managing members.
roleDescriptions.contributor: Can add events, photos and stories, but can't edit other people's entries.
roleDescriptions.viewer: Can only view the tree and profiles, without changing anything.

members.inviteCreated: Invitation created. If the email doesn't arrive, send this link manually:
members.removeBody: {name} will immediately lose access to all of this family's data.

shareLinks.created: Link created. Save it now — it can't be shown again, only revoked and replaced.
shareLinks.noPublicPeople: No one is marked “public” — mark at least one person in their profile, or choose “Everything family members can see”.
shareLinks.noPeople: There are no people in this family yet.
